'''Anoat''' was one of three habitable [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], located in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was located between the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]] and the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]].

==History==
[[File:TheHuntForHanSolo-TCGADT.png|thumb|left|250px|''Slave I'' prepares to pursue the ''Millennium Falcon'' in the Anoat system]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Thief/Legends|thief]] arrested since 30 years admitted to have hidden his stolen goods in the sewage system of Anoat.<ref name="Thief">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Filthy Thief}}</ref>

The planet, while habitable, was generally inhospitable, like the other worlds of the Anoat system. Discovered shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]] group, [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists began to populate a part of the world as excavation began. Disregarding the fragile ecosystem, the miners shattered the earth and poisoned the atmosphere. Leaving the world a ruin, many of the settlements were abandoned due to pollution.<ref name="TEA" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the planet's only settlement, [[Anoat City]], served as the secret base of Imperial weapons designer [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebus (Galactic Empire)|Rebus]]. During the war, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Mission to Anoat|extracted]] Rebus from his hideout in the sewers of Anoat City and brought him to justice.<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> Later, in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] passed through the Anoat system while running from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back novelization">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'']] novelization</ref>

During the [[New Republic era]], Anoat was resettled again under a Figg charter.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Anoat in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], which is actually located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
